{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for loyal customers with completed status (only these are valid for conversion calculation)
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the fraction of converted orders among loyal, completed orders
n_converted = loyal_completed['converted'].sum()
n_total = len(loyal_completed)
fraction_converted = n_converted / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Number of loyal, completed orders: {n_total}")
print(f"Number of converted loyal, completed orders: {n_converted}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
